title: Road Infrastructure Condition Assessment and Asset Management
raw_description: The City of Kelowna Public Works Department requires a civil engineering firm to conduct a comprehensive road infrastructure condition assessment. Deliverables include: pavement condition index surveys for 500km of roads, culvert and drainage assessments, bridge load ratings, GIS mapping of asset inventory, and a 10-year capital maintenance plan. The vendor must hold a Professional Engineer (P.Eng) designation in BC, carry appropriate professional liability insurance, and have experience with municipal asset management programs. Reporting will be delivered via ArcGIS dashboards.

expected_risks: civil engineering scope — Your Organization disqualifier
ground_truth.rationale: Clear disqualifier: civil engineering and physical infrastructure assessment. P.Eng required. No data analytics or BI content beyond incidental ArcGIS use. Should be rejected at qualification with very low score.
